service.description: The sprints of a project: the open ones (in progress first, then the planned by start) and, with includeClosed, the completed ones (the latest first), each with its dates as text, goal, capacity and status label.

The Backlog screen's data for a project the user sees: the project (key, name, estimate unit, whether it plans in sprints (WstModules backlog), runs several sprints at once, and what the user may do), the backlog rows and each open sprint with its rows, item count, total size against its capacity; and the filter options. The filters (assignee, type, label, component, epic: under a top-level item at any depth, and text) narrow the rows of both panes, not a sprint's total. Each row is as WorkItems decorates it, with its epic (its top-level item) and its size in the project's unit.

A drag in the Backlog: the items (workEffortIds, in their order) go to the sprint sprintWorkEffortId (empty for the backlog) and, in that list, right after previousWorkEffortId, else before nextWorkEffortId, one after the other (set#TaskSprint, set#TaskBacklogRank); with neither (an empty list) only the sprint changes. Each item on its own, in its own transaction, by one who may change it: one that fails is logged and named, the rest go on.
One item of rank#BacklogItems: its sprint when it changes, then its rank.

A sprint and its project's access (get#ProjectAccess with need): sprint (the record), project, canView, canUpdate (the team: rank, plan, edit, start, complete), canManage. A sprint the user may not see is "not available".

SprintForm: a new sprint of the project (no workEffortId; mantle create#Sprint) or the changes to one (update#Sprint): name, goal, start and end (yyyy-MM-dd), capacity in the project's unit. By the project's team.
StartSprint: begins a planned sprint with its dates and goal (mantle start#Sprint, which refuses while another is in progress unless the project allows several, naming it). By the project's team.
CompleteSprint: ends a sprint in progress (mantle complete#Sprint); its open items go to carryToSprintId, else by carryTo (next, new or backlog). By the project's team.
"Plan in sprints": turns the Backlog and sprints module on for the project (WstModules backlog), by one who manages it.

The open sprints of a project (in progress, then planned) as drop-down options (key, text) for the sprint fields of quick add, QuickWorkItem, WorkItemDetail and the bulk change; none for a project the user does not see.

SprintDetail's data: the sprint (name, goal, dates, capacity, status and its label), its project, what the user may do, the numbers (committed, completed, remaining, days left) and burndown by day, the scope changes and the items with what became of each (mantle.work.ProjectReportServices.get#SprintBurndown), the item rows as WorkItems decorates them, and for Complete the counts and the open sprints the open items may go to.
